payload.reason: The evidence provides clear comparisons between word and morpheme segmentation metrics, indicating that performance varies based on the type of supervision used.

claims.text: Segmentation metrics are better with morpheme-based references in unsupervised settings, indicating morphemes may provide more accurate segmentation.
With word supervision, word-level metrics improve while morpheme-based scores decrease, suggesting a trade-off in performance based on the type of annotation used.
Morfessor outperforms SentencePiece on boundary and token-level F-scores but not at the type level, indicating different strengths in word versus morpheme segmentation.
